constants.remedy: Every check is report severity: nothing here gates records -- add, and a finding is a lead to read, not a wrong value. tests/checks-baseline.test.ts fails when a run raises any count above the number pinned in data/omics/checks-baseline.json, so the backlog can be worked down but not grown. A failure on an unrelated evidence pull request means the records that pull request adds raised the check and rule the failure names: a backlog ratchet, not a correctness failure. Two ways forward, both in that same pull request. Fix the new findings: npm run checks -- report writes one row per finding to maintenance/reports/checks-<date>.tsv, and the rows carrying the named rule are the ones to read. Or raise the baseline: rerun npm run checks -- baseline and add a dated review in docs/reviews/ saying which rule rose, by how much, and why the new findings stand.

C9: this implementation reports 187 groups where the design carried 171. The difference is the grouping, not the store, and duplicate_artifact.ts says why.
